claims.verbatim:
Steamship Atlantic, Hoyer, Bremen May 10, Southampton
14th, with mdse and passengers, to Ruger Bros. Had three
births on the passage. May 10, passed schr Jos W Webster,
going up Weser river; 24th, lat 41 37, lon 56 15, exchanged
signals with an Inman steamer bound E; lat 41 37, lon 56 15,
passed a brig rigged propeller bound W; 25th, lat 41 34, lon
61 39, an American bark showing white flag with red cross,
bound E; 26th, lat 41 07, lon 66 16, steamship Ericeson[?],
bound E; 27th, 10 miles E of light-ship, brig Castella, of
Richmond, foremast gone and under jury mast, bound in.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 28 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
